review_candidates.title: Officer, Programs and Operations
review_candidates.company: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies - IFRC
review_candidates.description: Organizational Context The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (“the Federation”) is the world’s largest volunteer-based humanitarian network with 191 members National Societies. As part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity and universality. The Secretariat of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies’ (IFRC) strives to ensure focus, clarity, and efficiency and accountability in all results. The Secretariat, headquartered in Geneva, has five decentralized regional offices: one of which is the Americas, guided by the Secretariat strategies for implementation and areas of focus that builds on the vision of strategy 2030. The IFRC Regional Office for the Americas is organized in two main blocks: 1) a group of service-based departments and geographical configurations of (i) Country Cluster Delegation - CCD (ii) Country Delegation(s) - CD , as well as the Deputy Regional Director, under the direct management of the Regional Director; and 2) six building blocks composed by (i) Partnerships and Resource Development, (ii) Policy, Strategy and Knowledge; (iii) Communication, (iv) Disaster and Crisis: Preparedness, Response, and Recovery, (v) Health and Care (that include WASH), (vi) Logistics, each of them led by the Deputy Regional Director. This position is part of the Colombia Country Delegation (CD), which in turn, is part of the CCD for the Andean countries team, member of Americas Regional Office (ARO) team and has mandate for policy, operational and programmatic support to the members through Country and Cluster delegations, and directly when required. The CD provides coordination in disaster management, high level representation of the IFRC, advocacy and communications, National Society capacity building, and resource mobilization, Country Operational Plan, resourcing, partnership development in Colombia. These are some of the essential elements to ensure an effective membership coordination and management of strategic partnerships and resources that support the work and increase the influence of IFRC and National Societies in the region. IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. Job Purpose The Programme and Operations Officer will support the work of the Earthquake Emergency Appeal Coordinator with the design, planning, implementation and follow-up of agreed activities. The overall aim of this role is to assists the EQ Operations Coordinator in effectively leading, coordinating and managing programme or sector staff; ensuring a positive working environment and an appropriate structure to optimise team performance and the exchange of information; and ensuring that objectives are met in accordance with the Federation’s standards, policies and procedures. Furthermore, the Operations and Programmes Officer will support the timely and proper fulfilment of both programmatic and administrative commitments relating to the Secretariat’s and the CRC’s internal procedures concerning conditional and unconditional funds from the Appeal. Job Duties And Responsibilities Programme Management and Support Provide support in programme areas including disaster management, climate and environment and community resilience, in line with agreed plans and priorities Work closely with counterparts to support implementation of agreed plans and budgets Ensure the application of IFRC policies, procedures, and standards; ensure that project implementation is timely, relevant, effective and in line with best international practice Support project data collection and information management and contribute to planning, monitoring, evaluation and reporting of programme activities in close cooperation with National Societies and IFRC counterparts Contribute to effective, timely and comprehensive reporting to partners and back donors in collaboration with the respective technical colleagues Provide assistance to Operations and Programs in the development of project proposal and in preparation of grant applications and resource mobilization for both internal and external donors Project and pledge management With guidance and support from the technical team, the incumbent will: Provide support in managing agreements and projects, as well as various processes related to ERP integration with other IFRC systems Check projects on consistency and compliance, especially with policies, procedures, standards, methodologies, instruments, theories and practices Check projects on effectiveness, especially for meeting (and adapting to) the needs of people, expectations and capacities of national societies and partners. Check projects on efficiency, especially for wasting supplies, money and time. Contribute to the implementation of project activity workplans and support the achievement of planned outputs. Coordinate pledge-based reporting, including preparation and submission of such report in alignment with reporting conditions together with the PMER Officer for the Emergency Appeal. Ensure that reporting deadlines and IFRC reporting standards and donor-requirements are met. Contribute, together with the PMER officer to effective and efficient donor financial and narrative reporting for pledge and non-standard reports, ensuring required information is prepared and shared to support performance evaluation. Provide support in planning, implementing, monitoring, reporting, and evaluating project activities linked to the Pledge Job Duties And Responsibilities (continued) Duty of Care (in The Assigned Area Of Operations And Responsibility) Identify and assess the foreseeable risks to the EA personnel and operations as guided by the Ops. Coordinator. Implement mitigation measures to eliminate, avoid, or reduce foreseeable security risks to the EA personnel, assets, and the overall organization as guided by the Ops. Coordinator Implement contingency measures to react to and manage security incidents as guided by the Ops. Coordinator Ensure personnel are informed of the risks and processes in place to deal with those risks. Ensure personnel receive the necessary training, practice and instructions to manage and respond to the foreseeable risks relating to their activities and work environment. Contribute to identify risks and mitigation measures put in place to safeguard all the components listed above are working as intended. Coordination In accordance with the IFRC’s Way of Working in regard to the Emergency Appeal: Contribute to ensure that the Colombian Red Cross Society lead coordination and cooperation platforms in the assigned area, whilst respecting their sovereignty, their auxiliary role and their central role in humanitarian action. Predictable and consistent support: Support and inform the raising of consistent humanitarian funding and support across all regions, in line with local needs. Unity through a single Federation: Foster and lead by example a unified Federation centered on shared objectives, with the National Society at the heart of all efforts. A qualified and impactful Red Pillar presence: Contribute to the Country Delegation efforts at ensuring an effective and impactful presence of the Red Cross and Red Crescent in in the assigned area. Transformative change: Promoting a system-wide transformation towards locally-led, needs-based humanitarian models, with innovative and flexible funding mechanisms. A shift in mindset: Foster a common understanding and trust in local leadership, through open communication and solutions that reduce complexity and dependency. Transparency and accountability: Commit to transparent partnerships, equitable collaboration and accountability, ensuring clear financial reporting, supporting National Societies’ financial management systems and reducing duplication of effort. In regard to the EA, contribute to a common planning, monitoring, evaluation, and reporting framework. Support a single data collection mechanism and promote a common accountability framework. Work with the Emergency Appeal Ops. Coordinator to develop, implement and review contingency planning for identified threats in operational areas, as well as the development of capacities within the NS for emergency response. Duties applicable to all staff Actively work towards the achievement of the Federation Secretariat’s goals Abide by and work in accordance with the Red Cross and Red Crescent principles Perform any other work-related duties and responsibilities that may be assigned by the line manager Education Education University degree in Social Sciences or related field (Required) Experience Required At least 3 years of relevant work experience in the humanitarian sector Experience in managing projects and plans, as well as in budgeting, reporting and monitoring and evaluation Proven experience in at least one key technical area of focus (community resilience, climate action, disaster management) Experience in training and/or capacity building (Preferred) Experience in the Red Cross Red Crescent Movement Experience with data collection and information management tools Knowledge, Skills and Languages Required Goal-oriented and solution-focused Strong interpersonal and communication skills Good analytical, synthesis & writing skills Ability to work to under pressure and with tight deadlines Demonstrated capacity to work effectively in a multi-cultural environment Proven track record in project planning, monitoring and design Proficient in Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint or similar applications Fluently spoken and written English and Spanish Competencies, Values and Comments Core competencies: Communication; Collaboration and Teamwork; Judgement and Decision Making; National Society and Customer Relations; Creativity and Innovation; Building Trust Functional Competencies: Strategic orientation; Building Alliances; Leadership; Empowering others Values: Respect for diversity; Integrity; Professionalism; Accountability

review_candidates.description: Job Description Title: I.T. Application Support Analyst- Husky (India) Chennai Id: 21360 Type: FullTime Location: Chennai, India At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Job Description The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required. Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability Incident investigation and resolution Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1. Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds. Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems. Functional support Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes. Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior. Assist users with complex process or application-related questions. Integration troubleshooting Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications. Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows. Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries. Escalation to Level 3 Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention. Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact. Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation. Problem management and root-cause analysis Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems. Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis. Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions. Change and release support Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates. Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate. Support deployments and post-deployment verification. Monitoring and operational support Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces. Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available. Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels. Ticket and SLA management Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them. Prioritize according to severity and business impact. Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users. Knowledge management Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues. Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently. Share knowledge with other ERP support team members. Business and IT coordination Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams. Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists. Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders. CRITICAL CAPABILITIES Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ERP Functional Expertise Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012). Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules. Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues. Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Systematic investigation of complex incidents. Identify symptom vs. root cause. Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history. Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable. Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications. Trace transactions across systems. Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it. Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems. Incident Ownership & Prioritization Take ownership from escalation through resolution. Assess business impact, urgency, and priority. Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams. Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders. Technical Analysis Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages. Basic understanding of databases and data structures. Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate. Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams. Requirements EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related) EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred. 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset. 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace.
